evals.name: Scan and Identify Duplicate & Fragmented Clusters
evals.prompt: Scan the ai-agent-toolkit repository for overlapping skills or duplicate rules and report consolidation candidates.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive duplicate scan report highlighting exact duplicates and grouping related skills into topic clusters.
assertions: Executes scripts/scan_duplicates.py across the repository or specified module
Clusters related skills and rules by semantic topic and identifies merge candidates
Strictly excludes shared/generators and internal auxiliary directories from modification

evals.name: Execute Zero-Loss 5-Pillar Skill Consolidation
evals.prompt: Consolidate two fragmented skills in the repository into a single master 5-pillar skill bundle without losing unique knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Refactoring plan merging references, scripts, assets, evals, and Gotchas into the master bundle and safely pruning the redundant secondary directory.
assertions: Preserves all unique instructions, code examples, schemas, and Gotchas in the master bundle
Validates the master skill bundle with validate_skill.py and runs evals
